The file's layout was measured from one 16 KB read of its header, 2026-11-11. 0.11.0: tests/worldpop-catalogue.test.mjs (sixteen Global2 years for Rwanda, the address as WorldPop publishes it, no link for a folder without a 100 m total) and tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs (both releases offered, the year kept across them); the 23 raster browser tests on the standard dialog; Chromium. 0.11.1: tests/raster.test.mjs (the window cut to the raster, the overhang said, no overlap refused; a 16.8 MB window validated and round-tripped through an encrypted workflow) and tests/stored-in-parts.browser.mjs (a 150 MB file stored in parts and read back whole); Botswana whole measured outside the application's dialogs, 2026-11-12, Chromium. 0.11.2: tests/worldpop-catalogue.test.mjs (Botswana 2025, Global2: units, year, title, URL; another name not guessed at); Chromium not run for this path.
